images.title: A square of side 6 has area 36
images.purpose: Shows a square of side 6 units made of 36 unit squares, so its area is 6 squared, which is 36, not 12.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. One large square grid in the centre with its two sides marked and one equation below.
images.exact_structure: One large square divided into a 6 by 6 grid of exactly 36 equal unit squares, all filled teal (#0072B2) with thin white grid lines. A dimension line along the bottom edge is labelled 6, and a dimension line along the left edge is labelled 6. Below the square, centred: 6² = 36. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: The area of a square of side n is n × n, written n squared.
images.description: Shows a square of side 6 units made of 36 unit squares, so its area is 6 squared, which is 36, not 12.

image_decisions.why: Counting the 36 unit squares makes it clear that squaring means side times side, not doubling.
